caption: The drawing features a ceramic pitcher designed in the shape of an owl, with detailed feather patterns and round eyes. The pitcher is primarily brown with shades of yellowish-brown and darker brown accents, and it has a curved handle attached to the back, shaped to resemble part of the owl’s body. The inside of the pitcher and the rim are depicted in white or light gray. The drawing is centered within a rectangular border, and to the lower right, there is a separate inset rectangle containing a close-up side view of the pitcher’s handle, also rendered in brown tones. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
